comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Coordinates are real lat/lon, projected via route origin+scale. radius in compressed-world meters. Entries marked needs_owner_review need confirmation against lived knowledge before shipping.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow sand spit connecting Norman Manley Airport to the mainland — sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: First roundabout off the Palisadoes; gateway into Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial and residential area along Windward Road

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Inner-city Kingston neighbourhood along Windward Road

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital and largest city — heart of Jamaica

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major junction linking uptown and downtown Kingston

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's CBD — hotels, banks, and Emancipation Park

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Commercial hub of St. Andrew, anchored by the 1813 clock tower

communities.name: Six Miles
communities.note: Western gateway out of Kingston, named for its distance from the city centre

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former colonial capital of Jamaica — the route bypasses the town centre

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Village at the foot of the gorge — Flat Bridge and the Rio Cobre

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine market town; home of the WINDALCO alumina plant

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St. Catherine market town — "Carry mi ackee go a Linstead market"

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St. Ann hill-country crossroads between Kingston, Ocho Rios and Spanish Town

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre canopied gully road through the rainforest — St. Ann's pride

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann resort town on the north coast — journey's end
